course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: A 200 response arrived: was the contract met?
goal: Design a bounded HTTP contract and test success, rejection and timeout against a local mock.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P10. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: The server replied, but its body is not what was promised. Connectivity and status 200 are only part of the contract. Use an own local service to distinguish success, explicit refusal and no timely response.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Own copy, common module and separate caller
paragraphs: Continue your own training copy after P10. Preserve a DT backup and previous sources, restore into a separate new infobase and verify its path. Preserve prior work and records.

Put functions in server common module УчебныйОбмен: Server/Server call enabled, Client, Global, Privileged disabled. Данные.bsl and Приложение.bsl belong to different modules. Append only missing definitions and retain one copy of each helper.
Preserve the previous application handler first. Remove only the added startup call after one experiment. Your UUIDs and own process port may differ from the author’s observation.

This additional experiment needs Node.js. Save the known mock.mjs from the example files into a separate own folder. In that folder’s PowerShell run node mock.mjs ready.json. Only after your process is ready, read its ready.json and use its port value in the BSL call. If startup fails, use no occupied unknown port.

The function fixes the host at 127.0.0.1. The displayed caller’s number belongs to the author’s actual run; replace it with your new process’s port value. The helper stops after 3minutes; Ctrl+C stops your own process. Use no real service, secret or Account.

sections.title: Exchange is an external boundary
paragraphs: An HTTP request crosses into another participant’s failures and lifecycle. Specify method, path, body schema, response codes and size limits. A connection is not an accepted request; a 200 with a malformed body also fails the application contract. Do not send real data to public teaching services.

This advanced exercise uses only an own 127.0.0.1 с портом собственного mock service, not a learner-controlled arbitrary host or Nexus. Inspect mock.mjs in the extracted source kit: loopback-only GET and synthetic responses. No tokens or real data.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныйОбмен common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: Actual 1C sends GET only to the own loopback mock. /health returns 200 and the service marker, /reject returns 400, and /slow outlasts the one-second timeout. The three labelled flags test different properties; this is not a browser simulation of HTTPСоединение.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

Our known helper adds synthetic /not-json for the new task to the three original routes. This is an own local process, not the Nexus server. Checking body length after receipt is not a streaming network limit.

sections.title: Policy selects addresses
paragraphs: A user-suppliedURLmust not grant server code arbitrary internal-network/file access. Use a fixed loopback mock without secrets; it is not a production endpoint. RealHTTPSrequires certificate validation and redirect policy. DisablingTLSvalidation to make tests green is unacceptable.

Node.js from its official distribution is needed only for this extra HTTP exercise. In PowerShell at the kit directory run node mock.mjs ready.json. Require the own process readiness file; if the port is occupied and startup fails, never contact the unknown service. Beginner labs need no such setup.

Open the ready.json produced by your process in a text editor. Replace the port number from ready.json in the caller with its numeric port value; the marker is not a predefined BSL variable. The host remains 127.0.0.1.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: HTTP 200 arrives, but the body violates the contract. Can the operation be considered accepted?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. A transport observation does not establish the application result. Check version, types and required fields. A timeout also does not establish that a remote participant did nothing; a safe retry needs the same intention key.

sections.title: Responses can be ambiguous
paragraphs: A timeout after sending does not reveal whether the remote side accepted the request. Blind retry can duplicate work. Use a requestIDand verification/retry policy. Distinguish transport failure, business 4 xx, temporary 5 xxand schema failure. Log safe IDs rather than tokens or complete payloads.

Append the complete BSL to server common module УчебныйОбмен. Call ОпытHTTP from the existing startup handler and print all three result fields. Save, F7 and run: health gives 200 plus own-service marker, reject gives 400 and slow raises a 1-second timeout. No response creates a request document.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: Method, route, status and body are distinct contract parts. The independent task distinguishes invalid-body 200 from valid 200. HTTPS, redirects, arbitrary-URL protection and production exchange are not tested here.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Unparsed text under status 200 is accepted, or a timeout automatically generates a new requestID. The first confuses transport and schema; the second may duplicate an effect. Keep those checks separate and record unknown outcomes explicitly.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Mocks control outcomes
paragraphs: Prepare valid 200, 400, 500, delay and oversized-body cases. Set expectations before running the BSL client. The mock inspects method/path but does not replace the 1C platform. Browserfetchor aJSmodel is not execution ofHTTPConnection.

The mock exits after three minutes; Ctrl+C may stop only its own terminal process. Remove the startup call and retain all observations. The 4096 check is after string materialization, not a streaming network limit. This local test does not prove HTTPS, redirect policy, arbitrary-host SSRF protection or real external integration.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: On the same own mock, request /missing and observe 404. Then /not-json returns 200 with intentionally invalid JSON: parsing must refuse it. A positive /health control parses as an object with service=nexus-course-mock and status=ok. Report both status codes separately from the two body-validation flags.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныйОбмен common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: Only the described training paths are established. Real HTTPS services, arbitrary URLs, concurrent first delivery, crash recovery, background queues and scheduling remain NOT RUN. Technical observations, self-report and learner understanding are separate.
Explain transport status, body validity, business result and an unknown timeout outcome separately.

selfcheck.prompt: HTTP 200 arrives, but the body violates the contract. Can the operation be considered accepted?
options: No: check status and body separately
Yes: if the connection is fast
selfcheck.feedback: No. A transport observation does not establish the application result. Check version, types and required fields. A timeout also does not establish that a remote participant did nothing; a safe retry needs the same intention key.

selfcheck.prompt: Does HTTP 200 alone establish business success?
Does a timeout establish that the server did not accept a request?
options: No: the outcome may be unknown
Yes: the server always cancels everything
Yes: a new requestID fixes it
selfcheck.feedback: Explain transport status, body validity, business result and an unknown timeout outcome separately.

selfcheck.prompt: Explain your own changed case: what stayed the same, what changed, and which fresh read demonstrates it?
selfcheck.feedback: The answer is not graded automatically. Compare the reasoning with concrete observations from your work.
